t.zh: 另一座城市的街道是斜的：每一步只能往右走一格，或者往右下斜着走一格。每个路口还是要花体力。从左上角走到右下角，最少要花多少体力？
t.en: In another city the streets are slanted: each step goes one cell right, or one cell diagonally down and right. Every crossing still costs energy. Going from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner, what is the least energy you can spend?

t.zh: 到一个路口的最后一步，要么从左边来，要么从左上斜着来。这座城里，有的路口从起点根本走不到。
t.en: The last step into a crossing comes either from the left or diagonally from the up-left. In this city, some crossings can’t be reached from the start at all.

t.zh: 这一关的电路板要做成元件，以后用在来路更多的地方，所以板上多了一个输入「来路三」。这座城市里没有第三条来路，它一直是「—」；把它和左边、左上一起接进取较小，元件才有三个来路。
t.en: This level’s board becomes the part , to be used where more ways lead in, so the board has one more input, “way in 3”. This city has no third way in, so it is always “—”; wire it into the min together with left and up-left, and the part gets three ways in.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>，输出 a + b。它和「加起来」汇合器不一样：只要有一边是「—」，结果就是「—」。
t.en: A new component: the <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, which outputs a + b. It differs from the “sum” Merger: if either side is “—”, the result is “—”.

goal.zh: 每一步只能往右走一格，或往右下斜着走一格，每经过一个路口（包括起点和终点）都要花掉它左上角写的体力。算出从左上角到右下角最少要花多少体力。
goal.en: Each step goes one cell right or one cell diagonally down and right, and every crossing you pass through (start and end included) costs the energy in its top-left corner. Work out the least energy needed to get from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.

how.zh: 视野里的「左上」，就是斜着走过来的那一格。没通过时，看看机器人在走不到的路口上写了什么。
how.en: In the view, “up-left” is the cell a diagonal step comes from. If a test fails, look at what the robot wrote on the crossings it can’t reach.

say.zh: 这座城市不能往下直走，从上面是走不过来的。
say.en: In this city you can’t go straight down, so nothing arrives from above.

hints.zh: 从左上出发，只往右和往右下走，能走到左下角吗？那里该写什么？
hints.en: Leaving the top left and going only right or down-right, can you ever reach the bottom-left corner? What should be written there?

hints.zh: 「加起来」汇合器会跳过「—」，所以走不到的路口加上体力，也成了一个数。用加法器加体力。
hints.en: The “sum” Merger skips “—”, so a crossing out of reach still turns into a number once its energy is added. Add the energy with an Adder.

hints.zh: 起点的来路全是「—」，加法器也会得出「—」。用放行闸在起点往取较小里送一个 0（常数放上去后，点它可以改成 0）。
hints.en: At the start every way in is “—”, so the Adder gives “—” too. Use a Pass gate to send a 0 into the min at the start (once the Constant is on the board, click it to change it to 0).

hints.zh: 「来路三」这一关一直是「—」，可它也是元件的一个口：和左边、左上一起接进取较小。
hints.en: “Way in 3” is always “—” in this level, but it is one of the part’s ports too: wire it into the min together with left and up-left.

title.en: Out of reach stays out of reach

body.zh: 走不到的路口没有来路，取较小得到「—」。「加起来」汇合器会跳过这个「—」，只留下体力，于是走不到的路口凭空有了一个数，还会被后面的路口挑中。
body.en: A crossing out of reach has no way in, so the min gives “—”. The “sum” Merger skips that “—” and keeps just the energy, so the crossing suddenly holds a number, and later crossings may pick it.

body.zh: 加法器只要一边是「—」，就输出「—」：走不到的路口一直是「—」，后面的路口取较小时会跳过它。
body.en: The Adder outputs “—” whenever either side is “—”: a crossing out of reach stays “—”, and later crossings skip it when they take the min.

note.zh: 加法器：有一边是「—」，结果就是「—」。「加起来」汇合器会跳过「—」。
note.en: Adder: if either side is “—”, so is the result. The “sum” Merger skips “—”.
